Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00188
⌈The returned buffer index value of type Eth_BufIdxType shall be greater then 216-1.
The value range for the buffer index shall be:
• 0x00 01 00 00 ... 0xFF FF FF FF: valid
